notes.title: 🎉 Release Date & Price Announcement! 🔥
notes.content:
Elemental Rush launches on July 18, 2025!
The full version will be available for $8 USD (price may vary by region). 💸
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657744/d9a74731580cbacce9a1cd9efe067bc829fd3c87.png"]

🔥 Ready for a challenge? Try out the free demo today and experience the elemental chaos!
💖 Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to stay updated!

🌪️💧🌿🔥 Let the elemental battle begin!
